content: Supabase Realtime: postgres_changes is processed single-threaded to keep order and authorizes each change per subscriber (100 subscribers = 100 RLS checks); with RLS on Large+ compute: 500 clients -> max 40 changes/s, 4000 clients -> 5 changes/s. Broadcast scales to 32k-250k concurrent users and >150k msg/s with auth. Recommendation: Broadcast from DB triggers (realtime.broadcast_changes) or from the API server; treat DB as source of truth and order by (created_at, id)/sequence, not by arrival. Verified against supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/benchmarks.
